sentences.text: A many-sorted signature has a set of sorts, and operation symbols, each with an arity, which is a word of sorts, and a sort.
Our running example has two sorts, s and t, and two symbols:
sigma, with arity s t and sort s, and tau, with arity s and sort t.
An algebra for this signature has a set for each sort.
It interprets sigma as a function that takes an element of sort s and one of sort t, and returns one of sort s; and tau as a function from sort s to sort t.
In a partial algebra, an operation may be undefined at some arguments.
